scope: Texas college students and youth: SNAP student rules, campus food pantries, FAFSA/TASFA help, Texas Youth Helpline, foster youth (PAL, ETV, tuition waiver, Transition Centers)

records.name: SNAP Food Benefits for College Students (Student Eligibility Rules)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: SNAP gives money on a Lone Star Card to buy groceries. College students enrolled half-time or more can get SNAP if they meet at least one special student exemption.
records.description_es: SNAP le da dinero en una tarjeta Lone Star para comprar comida. Los estudiantes de universidad que estudian medio tiempo o más pueden recibir SNAP si cumplen por lo menos una excepción especial para estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Students ages 18-49 enrolled at least half-time must meet one exemption, such as working 20+ hours a week, having work-study, getting TANF, being unable to work, being in an approved job training program, or caring for a dependent child. Regular SNAP income and resource rules also apply.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los estudiantes de 18 a 49 años que estudian por lo menos medio tiempo deben cumplir una excepción, como trabajar 20 horas o más por semana, tener un trabajo de estudio (work-study), recibir TANF, no poder trabajar, estar en un programa aprobado de capacitación para el trabajo o cuidar a un hijo dependiente. También aplican las reglas normales de ingresos y recursos de SNAP.
documents_needed: Proof of student exemption (for example work-study award letter or pay stubs showing 20+ hours per week)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com, or call 2-1-1 (option 2) for help. Many campuses (such as UT Austin's UT Outpost) have navigators who help students apply.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com, o llame al 2-1-1 (opción 2) para recibir ayuda. Muchas universidades (como UT Outpost en UT Austin) tienen personas que ayudan a los estudiantes a solicitar.
records.notes: Texas Works Handbook B-410 lists 8 exemptions: unable to work; working avg 20+ hrs/week; work-study during school year; WIOA/Choices/SNAP E&T/TAA or similar program; on-the-job training; approved for TANF; caring for a dependent child (age conditions apply); single parent enrolled full-time caring for a child under 12. Student age range is 18 through 49. Phone and apply link confirmed on hhs.texas.gov/services/food/snap-food-benefits.

records.name: Texas Youth Helpline
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS)
records.description_en: A free, private helpline for kids, teens, and families in crisis. You can call, text, or chat 24/7 to talk, make a plan, and get referrals to low-cost help.
records.description_es: Una línea de ayuda gratis y privada para niños, adolescentes y familias en crisis. Puede llamar, mandar mensaje de texto o chatear las 24 horas, los 7 días, para hablar, hacer un plan y recibir referencias a ayuda de bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For youth, parents, guardians, and families in Texas who are having problems or are in crisis, including runaway youth.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para jóvenes, padres, tutores y familias en Texas que tienen problemas o están en crisis, incluyendo jóvenes que se escaparon de casa.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text 1-800-989-6884, or use the chat on the DFPS Youth Helpline website. You do not have to give your name.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un texto al 1-800-989-6884, o use el chat en la página de la Línea de Ayuda para Jóvenes de DFPS. No tiene que dar su nombre.
records.notes: Confidential; not a reporting hotline and not tied to law enforcement. Offers free messaging for runaway youth to contact family and connects to Operation Home Free (free transportation home). Referral database of 2,000+ Texas services.

records.name: 2-1-1 Texas
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: 2-1-1 Texas is a free helpline that connects you to local help like food, housing, bills, health care, and child care. You can call or chat online.
records.description_es: 2-1-1 Texas es una línea de ayuda gratis que le conecta con ayuda local, como comida, vivienda, pago de cuentas, salud y cuidado de niños. Puede llamar o chatear en línea.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas, including college students, who needs help finding local services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas, incluyendo estudiantes universitarios, que necesite ayuda para encontrar servicios locales.
records.how_to_apply: Dial 2-1-1 or 1-877-541-7905, or chat at 211texas.org in English or Spanish.
records.how_to_apply_es: Marque 2-1-1 o 1-877-541-7905, o chatee en 211texas.org en inglés o español.
records.notes: Also the helpline for SNAP/Medicaid application questions.

records.name: UT Outpost Food Pantry and Career Closet
records.organization: The University of Texas at Austin, Student Outreach & Support
records.description_en: A free campus food pantry and career closet. Students can get up to 20 pounds of food a month, toiletries, menstrual and parenting products, and two outfits per semester.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida y un clóset de ropa profesional gratis en el campus. Los estudiantes pueden recibir hasta 20 libras de comida al mes, artículos de higiene, productos menstruales y para bebés, y dos conjuntos de ropa por semestre.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All currently enrolled UT Austin students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes inscritos actualmente en UT Austin.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during open hours at the Student Services Building. One food visit per week.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el Student Services Building durante el horario de atención. Puede ir por comida una vez por semana.
records.address: 100 W Dean Keeton St, Student Services Building (SSB) G1.406
records.hours: Food pantry (September): Tue-Thu 1-6 pm, Fri 1-5 pm, 1st and 3rd Saturdays 10 am-2 pm. Career Closet: Tue 2-4 pm, Wed 1-3 pm, Fri 1-4 pm.
records.notes: Email utoutpost@austin.utexas.edu. Hours change by month/semester; check the page. Satellite locations also exist.

records.name: UT Outpost SNAP Application Help (Site and Peer Navigators)
records.organization: The University of Texas at Austin, Student Outreach & Support
records.description_en: Trained UT staff and peer navigators help students check if they qualify for SNAP and fill out the application.
records.description_es: Personal capacitado de UT y estudiantes guías ayudan a los estudiantes a ver si califican para SNAP y a llenar la solicitud.
records.eligibility_summary_en: UT Austin students who want help applying for SNAP food benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de UT Austin que quieren ayuda para solicitar los beneficios de comida SNAP.
documents_needed: Documents listed on Texas HHS Form H1858 (for example ID and proof of income)
records.how_to_apply: Book a SNAP Advising Session online, or email or call Student Outreach & Support.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita de asesoría de SNAP en línea, o mande un correo o llame a Student Outreach & Support.
records.address: 100 W Dean Keeton St, Student Services Building (SSB) 4.400
records.notes: Email studentlife@austin.utexas.edu.

records.name: UT Austin Student Emergency Fund
records.organization: The University of Texas at Austin, Student Outreach & Support
records.description_en: Gives money to students facing a sudden emergency, like medical bills, medicine, City of Austin utility bills, lost belongings after a fire, or safety needs.
records.description_es: Da dinero a estudiantes que tienen una emergencia repentina, como cuentas médicas, medicinas, cuentas de servicios de la Ciudad de Austin, cosas perdidas en un incendio o gastos de seguridad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Currently enrolled UT Austin students with a documented recent, short-term emergency. Awards depend on available funds.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes inscritos actualmente en UT Austin con una emergencia reciente y de corto plazo que puedan comprobar. La cantidad depende del dinero disponible.
documents_needed: Proof of the emergency (for example medical bills, police report, employment notice)
records.how_to_apply: Submit the application through the Student Outreach & Support portal with your documents. Processing usually takes about 5 business days.
records.how_to_apply_es: Envíe la solicitud en el portal de Student Outreach & Support con sus documentos. Normalmente tarda unos 5 días hábiles.
records.notes: Does NOT cover rent/housing, ongoing costs, technology, or tuition. Money cannot be given out after the last day of the semester. Email studentlife@austin.utexas.edu. Online application is a Maxient form linked from the page.

records.name: The 12th Can Food Pantry
records.organization: The 12th Can (Texas A&M University student organization)
records.description_en: A student-run food pantry at Texas A&M that gives out free prepackaged food bags on scheduled opening weeks.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida manejada por estudiantes en Texas A&M que da bolsas de comida empacada gratis durante las semanas en que abre.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All Texas A&M students, staff, and faculty in need.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes, empleados y profesores de Texas A&M que lo necesiten.
records.how_to_apply: Sign up when sign-ups are posted (Fridays 3:00-3:30 pm before opening weeks), or walk in during open hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase cuando se publiquen las inscripciones (los viernes de 3:00 a 3:30 pm antes de las semanas en que abre), o vaya sin cita durante el horario de atención.
records.address: Mail Services Building, Office #119, 330 Agronomy Rd
records.hours: Opens on a periodic schedule (a few days at a time); check the website for the next opening dates.
records.notes: Volunteer-run; email 12thcan.director@gmail.com. Reachable by bus Route #6, Vet School stop. The Sept 23-25, 2026 opening listed on the site has already passed; check the site for the next opening.

records.name: Texas A&M Student Life (Student Assistance and Case Management)
records.organization: Texas A&M University, Department of Student Life
records.description_en: Texas A&M's Student Life office helps students in hard times with case management, crisis help, food resources, free legal services, and support for pregnant and parenting students.
records.description_es: La oficina de Student Life de Texas A&M ayuda a estudiantes en momentos difíciles con manejo de casos, ayuda en crisis, recursos de comida, servicios legales gratis y apoyo para estudiantes embarazadas o con hijos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas A&M University students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de Texas A&M University.
records.how_to_apply: Call, text, or email Student Life, or visit the Student Services Building. For emergency money, also contact the Financial Aid office at (979) 847-1787.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame, mande un texto o un correo a Student Life, o visite el Student Services Building. Para dinero de emergencia, también comuníquese con la oficina de Ayuda Financiera al (979) 847-1787.
records.address: Student Services Building, 2nd Floor, 471 Houston St
records.notes: studentlife.tamu.edu does not use the name 'Student Assistance Services'; it lists case management, crisis assistance, food resources, free legal services, and pregnant/parenting support. Text line (979) 318-5086; email studentlife@tamu.edu. Financial Aid offers emergency aid based on need (per 12th Can resource list).

records.name: Cougar Cupboard
records.organization: University of Houston
records.description_en: A free campus food pantry where UH students can get up to 30 pounds of groceries each week, including fresh produce, grains, and proteins.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida gratis en el campus donde los estudiantes de UH pueden recibir hasta 30 libras de comida cada semana, incluyendo frutas y verduras frescas, granos y proteínas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All enrolled University of Houston students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes inscritos en la Universidad de Houston.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during open hours (Tuesday is by appointment only). Check Instagram @uhcupbrd for added hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite durante el horario de atención (los martes solo con cita). Revise Instagram @uhcupbrd para ver horarios extra.
records.address: 4200 Martin Luther King Blvd, Room R101
records.hours: Fall 2026: Tue 2-5 pm (appointments only), Wed 2-6 pm, Fri 10 am-2 pm, first Saturday of month 10 am-12 pm.
records.notes: Email uhcupbrd@cougarnet.uh.edu. Phone listed is the UH main line. Walk-ins welcome except Tuesday (appointment only).

records.name: Roadrunner Pantry
records.organization: The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio)
records.description_en: Free food pantry at UTSA's Main and Downtown campuses to help students get healthy food. Order-ahead pickup is available.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida gratis en los campus Main y Downtown de UTSA para ayudar a los estudiantes a conseguir comida saludable. Puede pedir por adelantado y recoger.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All UTSA students, staff, and faculty in need, with a valid UTSA ID.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes, empleados y profesores de UTSA que lo necesiten, con una identificación válida de UTSA.
records.how_to_apply: Visit a pantry location during open hours or order ahead online. For after-hours help, email the pantry.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite una despensa durante el horario de atención o haga su pedido en línea. Si necesita ayuda fuera de horario, mande un correo a la despensa.
records.address: Main Campus: Student Union 1.04.06; Downtown: Durango Building 1.306
records.hours: Main Campus: Tue-Thu and Sat 10 am-4 pm. Downtown: Mon-Thu 12-4 pm.
records.notes: Downtown pantry phone (210) 458-2267. Email roadrunnerpantry@utsa.edu. General Student Affairs line: (210) 458-4985.

records.name: UTSA Emergency Aid (Grants and Loans)
records.organization: The University of Texas at San Antonio, One Stop / Financial Aid
records.description_en: One-time emergency grants or short-term loans for UTSA students facing a sudden crisis like car repairs, eviction notice, childcare loss, theft, job loss, or medical emergency.
records.description_es: Becas de emergencia de una sola vez o préstamos a corto plazo para estudiantes de UTSA que tienen una crisis repentina, como reparación del carro, aviso de desalojo, pérdida de cuidado de niños, robo, pérdida del trabajo o emergencia médica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: UTSA students with a documented emergency. Grants require a completed FAFSA and other aid used first; students without a FAFSA may get a loan repaid within the semester.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de UTSA con una emergencia que puedan comprobar. Para las becas se necesita haber llenado la FAFSA y haber usado primero otra ayuda; los estudiantes sin FAFSA pueden recibir un préstamo que se paga dentro del semestre.
documents_needed: Documentation of the emergency (for example eviction notice, repair estimate, medical bill)
records.how_to_apply: Submit the online Emergency Aid Application. You can also request a Financial Aid Re-Evaluation with a One Stop counselor if your income changed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Envíe la solicitud de Ayuda de Emergencia en línea. Si sus ingresos cambiaron, también puede pedir una revisión de su ayuda financiera con un consejero de One Stop.
records.notes: Grants are one-time and while funds last. Toll-free (800) 669-0919; email onestop@utsa.edu.

records.name: UNT Food Pantry (Diamond Eagle Student Resource Center)
records.organization: University of North Texas, Dean of Students
records.description_en: Free groceries for UNT students once a week, plus a free clothing closet and professional clothes. Part of the Diamond Eagle Student Resource Center.
records.description_es: Comida gratis para estudiantes de UNT una vez por semana, además de un clóset de ropa gratis y ropa profesional. Es parte del Diamond Eagle Student Resource Center.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Currently enrolled UNT students facing food insecurity. Limit one visit per week.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes inscritos actualmente en UNT que no tienen suficiente comida. Se permite una visita por semana.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours with your student ID. If you cannot come during hours, email DESresources@unt.edu for an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya sin cita durante el horario de atención con su identificación de estudiante. Si no puede ir en ese horario, mande un correo a DESresources@unt.edu para hacer una cita.
records.hours: Aug 17-Dec 2026: Mon-Wed 10 am-5 pm, Thu closed, Fri 10 am-5 pm, Sat 10 am-3 pm, Sun closed.
records.notes: Recently relocated to 621 S. Welch St. Follows the university closure calendar.

records.name: UTEP Food Pantry
records.organization: The University of Texas at El Paso, Student Affairs
records.description_en: A free food pantry for UTEP students who do not have enough food.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida gratis para estudiantes de UTEP que no tienen suficiente comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: UTEP students experiencing food insecurity.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de UTEP que no tienen suficiente comida.
records.how_to_apply: Visit Memorial Gym during open hours. Check Instagram @utepfoodpantry for special hours during breaks.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el Memorial Gym durante el horario de atención. Revise Instagram @utepfoodpantry para ver horarios especiales durante las vacaciones.
records.notes: Email foodpantry@utep.edu. Wheelchair accessible, with help available on request. Special hours during breaks are posted on Instagram @utepfoodpantry.

records.name: UTRGV Student Food Pantry
records.organization: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley
records.description_en: Free food for UTRGV students at the Brownsville and Edinburg campuses. Enroll once, order online, then pick up on distribution days.
records.description_es: Comida gratis para estudiantes de UTRGV en los campus de Brownsville y Edinburg. Inscríbase una vez, pida en línea y recoja su comida en los días de entrega.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Currently enrolled UTRGV students.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes inscritos actualmente en UTRGV.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out a one-time enrollment form at your pantry location, submit an online food order, and pick it up on a distribution day.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene un formulario de inscripción una sola vez en la despensa que prefiera, haga su pedido de comida en línea y recójalo en un día de entrega.
records.hours: Last posted schedule (Spring 2026): Brownsville Mon 12-3 pm, Fri 1-4 pm; Edinburg Mon 1-4 pm, Fri 11:30 am-3 pm. Check the website for current hours.
records.notes: Two locations: Brownsville campus (BMAIN 1.312) and Edinburg campus (EUCTR 114). Email foodpantry@utrgv.edu. The website still shows Spring 2026 hours; confirm Fall 2026 hours by email.

records.name: Riverbat Bites Food Pantry
records.organization: Austin Community College
records.description_en: Free groceries, fresh food at some campuses, heated grab-and-go meals, and personal care items like diapers, wipes, and period products.
records.description_es: Comida gratis, comida fresca en algunos campus, comidas calientes para llevar y artículos de cuidado personal como pañales, toallitas húmedas y productos menstruales.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All currently enrolled ACC students, at all eleven campuses.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todos los estudiantes inscritos actualmente en ACC, en los once campus.
records.how_to_apply: Visit a campus pantry during open hours. Some campuses (like Elgin and Riverside) require a pre-order form; Highland offers appointments.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la despensa de su campus durante el horario de atención. Algunos campus (como Elgin y Riverside) piden hacer el pedido antes; Highland ofrece citas.
records.hours: Varies by campus (for example Highland Mon-Fri 8:30 am-7 pm). Check the website for your campus.
records.notes: Pantries at all 11 ACC campuses, including Cypress Creek, Eastview, Hays, Highland, Round Rock, Rio Grande, Riverside, Northridge, San Gabriel, South Austin and Elgin. Elgin and Riverside require pre-orders; Highland offers appointments and after-hours pickup. Counties reflect campus locations.

records.name: ACC C.A.R.E. Network (Basic Needs Support)
records.organization: Austin Community College
records.description_en: ACC coordinators help students with food, housing, child care, mental health counseling, emergency funds, and help applying for SNAP and Medicaid.
records.description_es: Los coordinadores de ACC ayudan a los estudiantes con comida, vivienda, cuidado de niños, consejería de salud mental, dinero de emergencia y ayuda para solicitar SNAP y Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: ACC students. Most students qualify; coordinators check eligibility for each program at your appointment.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de ACC. La mayoría de los estudiantes califican; los coordinadores revisan si usted califica para cada programa durante su cita.
records.how_to_apply: Take the Basic Needs Questionnaire at austincc.edu/studentneeds, or schedule an appointment in the Student Appointment Portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el Cuestionario de Necesidades Básicas en austincc.edu/studentneeds, o haga una cita en el Portal de Citas para Estudiantes.
records.address: ACC Round Rock Campus, Building 2000, Room 2110, 4400 College Park Drive
records.notes: Address/phone shown are for the Round Rock C.A.R.E. Network Center. ACC also has 'Campus Champions' support for former foster youth (per DFPS college partnerships page).

records.name: Eagle Markets Campus Food Pantries
records.organization: Houston City College (HCC, formerly Houston Community College)
records.description_en: Free campus food pantries with groceries and, at many campuses, hygiene and household items. Central Campus offers up to 60 pounds per visit, twice a month.
records.description_es: Despensas de comida gratis en los campus, con comida y, en muchos campus, artículos de higiene y para el hogar. El Central Campus da hasta 60 libras por visita, dos veces al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Currently enrolled HCC students. Each location has monthly visit limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes inscritos actualmente en HCC. Cada lugar tiene un límite de visitas al mes.
records.how_to_apply: Visit an Eagle Market during open hours at your campus. For other help, fill out HCC's Basic Need Questionnaire or email HCC Cares.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite un Eagle Market de su campus durante el horario de atención. Para otro tipo de ayuda, llene el Cuestionario de Necesidades Básicas de HCC o mande un correo a HCC Cares.
records.hours: Varies by campus: Central Mon-Fri 9 am-5 pm (varies); Coleman Mon-Wed 9 am-3:30 pm; Northline Mon-Fri 9:30 am-3:30 pm; Southeast Mon-Fri 8:30 am-4:30 pm; Spring Branch Mon-Fri 9:30 am-4 pm; West Loop Mon-Thu 9 am-2 pm.
records.notes: The college's website now uses the name Houston City College. Central Campus pantry: 1300 Holman, WW Harmon Bldg Rm 215. Phone is the main college number. Mobile food distributions also happen at some campuses.

records.name: TASFA (Texas Application for State Financial Aid)
records.organization: Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board
records.description_en: TASFA is a Texas financial aid form for students who cannot or do not file the FAFSA. It lets you apply for state grants and aid at Texas colleges.
records.description_es: La TASFA es un formulario de ayuda financiera de Texas para estudiantes que no pueden o no quieren llenar la FAFSA. Sirve para solicitar becas y ayuda del estado en universidades de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Texas residents who cannot or choose not to file the FAFSA. Students who file the FAFSA should not also file TASFA.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Texas que no pueden o deciden no llenar la FAFSA. Los estudiantes que llenan la FAFSA no deben llenar también la TASFA.
records.how_to_apply: The 2027-28 TASFA opens October 1, 2026. Fill it out online or get it from your college's financial aid office, which receives the completed form. Try the FAFSA first if you can, because it can get you more aid.
records.how_to_apply_es: La TASFA 2027-28 abre el 1 de octubre de 2026. Llénela en línea o pídala en la oficina de ayuda financiera de su universidad, que recibe el formulario completo. Si puede, llene primero la FAFSA, porque le puede dar más ayuda.
records.notes: THECB stresses the FAFSA gives access to more aid (federal, state and school). State aid programs include TEXAS Grant (universities) and Texas Educational Opportunity Grant/TEOG (community and technical colleges). Phone is THECB main line; students should usually contact their school's financial aid office.

records.name: Texas College Work-Study Program
records.organization: Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (run by each college)
records.description_en: State-funded part-time jobs that help students pay for college. Work-study can also help students meet a SNAP student exemption.
records.description_es: Trabajos de medio tiempo pagados en parte por el estado que ayudan a los estudiantes a pagar la universidad. El trabajo de estudio (work-study) también puede ayudar a cumplir una excepción de estudiante para SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Eligible students at Texas colleges with financial need, as set by state guidelines and the school.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes que califican en universidades de Texas y tienen necesidad económica, según las reglas del estado y de la escuela.
records.how_to_apply: File the FAFSA or TASFA, then ask your college's financial aid office about work-study jobs.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la FAFSA o la TASFA y luego pregunte en la oficina de ayuda financiera de su universidad por trabajos de work-study.
records.notes: THECB confirms the program exists (Texas Education Code 56.073); colleges receive yearly allocations and set details. Eligibility details come from each school's financial aid office. Per Texas Works Handbook B-410, work-study during the regular school year is a SNAP student exemption.

records.name: State College Tuition and Fee Waiver (Foster Care Exemption)
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services / Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board
records.description_en: Free tuition and fees at Texas public colleges and universities for current and former foster youth and youth adopted from DFPS care.
records.description_es: Matrícula y cuotas gratis en universidades públicas de Texas para jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care) y para jóvenes adoptados del cuidado de DFPS.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Youth who were in DFPS conservatorship on key dates (such as the day before turning 18, high school graduation, or adoption date), plus certain youth who returned to a parent at age 14 or older. DFPS says you must enroll before your 27th birthday; youth adopted with an Adoption Assistance Agreement have no age limit.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes que estaban bajo la custodia de DFPS en ciertas fechas (como el día antes de cumplir 18 años, el día de graduarse de la preparatoria o la fecha de adopción), y algunos jóvenes que regresaron con uno de sus padres a los 14 años o más. DFPS dice que debe inscribirse antes de cumplir 27 años; los jóvenes adoptados con un Acuerdo de Asistencia de Adopción no tienen límite de edad.
records.how_to_apply: Get admitted to a Texas public college, then ask your regional PAL staff or Adoption Assistance specialist for Form 1810 and give it to your school. Request a new Form 1810 for each school you attend.
records.how_to_apply_es: Primero sea aceptado en una universidad pública de Texas. Luego pida el Formulario 1810 al personal PAL de su región o a su especialista de Asistencia de Adopción, y entrégueselo a su escuela. Pida un nuevo Formulario 1810 para cada escuela a la que asista.
records.notes: AGE LIMIT: DFPS page (checked 2026-09-26) says enroll before your 27th birthday; an earlier THECB fact sheet cited age 25. Confirm with DFPS or the school. PAL participation is not required. Staff give a signed waiver letter (Form 1810) to present to the school registrar.

records.name: Education and Training Voucher (ETV) Program
records.organization: Texas DFPS (administered by BCFS Health and Human Services)
records.description_en: Up to $5,000 a year for college or job training costs such as rent, utilities, books, computers, childcare, transportation, and tuition.
records.description_es: Hasta $5,000 al año para gastos de universidad o de capacitación para el trabajo, como renta, servicios, libros, computadoras, cuidado de niños, transporte y matrícula.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Current or former foster youth ages 16-23, including youth who aged out, were adopted from foster care after 16, or were in Permanency Care Assistance after 16. Must have a high school diploma or GED, be enrolled at least 6 credit hours (3 for dual credit or summer), and keep satisfactory academic progress.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes de 16 a 23 años que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care), incluyendo quienes salieron del sistema al cumplir la mayoría de edad, fueron adoptados después de los 16 o estuvieron en Permanency Care Assistance después de los 16. Debe tener diploma de preparatoria o GED, estar inscrito en por lo menos 6 horas de crédito (3 en crédito dual o verano) y mantener un buen progreso en sus estudios.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at texasetv.com/apply, or call the ETV hotline for help. Your ETV Coordinator can help with school requirements.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en texasetv.com/apply, o llame a la línea de ETV para recibir ayuda. Su coordinador de ETV le puede ayudar con los requisitos de la escuela.
records.notes: Maximum 5 years of funding; amount depends on cost of attendance and other aid. Apply online or by mail, fax, or email (ETV@BCFS.net). Deadlines: Fall Oct 1, Spring Mar 1, Summer Jul 1. Administrative office: BCFS HHS, 4346 NW Loop 410, San Antonio, TX 78229.

records.name: Freshman and Sophomore Success Scholarship
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
records.description_en: A scholarship of $1,000 per semester (up to $2,000 for two semesters) for young adults who were in foster care and attend a Texas public college.
records.description_es: Una beca de $1,000 por semestre (hasta $2,000 por dos semestres) para jóvenes adultos que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care) y van a una universidad pública de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Young adults formerly in DFPS foster care attending a Texas state-funded community college, university, or technical college. Sophomores must have received the award both semesters as freshmen.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes adultos que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza de DFPS y van a un colegio comunitario, universidad o colegio técnico de Texas pagado por el estado. Para solicitarla en el segundo año, debe haberla recibido los dos semestres del primer año.
records.how_to_apply: Apply by August 1 (fall) or November 1 (spring) before each semester, using the application on the DFPS education resources page.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite antes del 1 de agosto (otoño) o del 1 de noviembre (primavera) antes de cada semestre, usando la solicitud en la página de recursos de educación de DFPS.
records.notes: Same page lists the C. Ed Davis PAL Scholarship ($1,000/year) for former foster youth in law-related majors. Texas colleges must help full-time former foster youth find housing during academic breaks.

records.name: Preparation for Adult Living (PAL)
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
records.description_en: PAL teaches foster youth life skills like money, housing, jobs, and health. It also offers a transitional living allowance and help paying room and board after leaving care.
records.description_es: PAL enseña a los jóvenes en cuidado de crianza (foster care) habilidades para la vida, como manejar dinero, vivienda, trabajo y salud. También ofrece una ayuda de dinero para vivir por su cuenta y ayuda para pagar casa y comida después de salir del cuidado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Youth 16 and older in foster care likely to stay until 18 (some regions serve 14+), with services through age 21. Room and board aftercare is for ages 18-21 who aged out of foster care and have financial need.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes de 16 años o más en cuidado de crianza que probablemente se queden hasta los 18 (algunas regiones atienden desde los 14), con servicios hasta los 21 años. La ayuda para casa y comida es para jóvenes de 18 a 21 años que salieron del cuidado al cumplir la mayoría de edad y tienen necesidad económica.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your caseworker or regional PAL staff (see the DFPS PAL staff list).
records.how_to_apply_es: Hable con su trabajador social o con el personal PAL de su región (vea la lista de personal PAL de DFPS).
records.notes: Transitional Living Allowance: up to $1,000 (no more than $500/month) after completing life-skills training and being employed, job-seeking, or in school. Aftercare Room & Board: up to $500/month, $3,000 total cap, ages 18-21, based on financial need. Services depend on funding.

records.name: Extended Foster Care
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
records.description_en: Lets young adults who turn 18 in foster care stay in a placement with DFPS support until age 21 while they finish school, go to college, or work.
records.description_es: Permite a los jóvenes que cumplen 18 años en cuidado de crianza (foster care) quedarse en un lugar de cuidado con apoyo de DFPS hasta los 21 años mientras terminan la escuela, van a la universidad o trabajan.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Young adults who turned 18 in DFPS care and are in high school/GED, in college, in an employment program, working 80+ hours a month, or unable to do these due to a documented medical condition.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes que cumplieron 18 años bajo el cuidado de DFPS y están en la preparatoria o GED, en la universidad, en un programa de empleo, trabajando 80 horas o más al mes, o que no pueden hacer estas cosas por una condición médica comprobada.
records.how_to_apply: Contact regional PAL staff for pre-screening, then sign a Voluntary Extended Foster Care Agreement and start a qualifying activity within 30 days.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con el personal PAL de su región para una revisión inicial. Luego firme un Acuerdo Voluntario de Cuidado de Crianza Extendido y empiece una actividad que califique dentro de 30 días.
records.notes: Depends on an available placement. Youth who left care may be able to return. Pamphlets in English and Spanish.

records.name: DFPS Youth Housing Program
records.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
records.description_en: Helps young adults leaving foster care find housing, including Foster Youth to Independence (FYI) vouchers, Housing Choice Vouchers, and supervised independent living.
records.description_es: Ayuda a jóvenes adultos que salen del cuidado de crianza (foster care) a encontrar vivienda, incluyendo vales de Foster Youth to Independence (FYI), vales de Housing Choice y programas de vida independiente supervisada.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Young adults ages 18-24 with foster care involvement.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes adultos de 18 a 24 años que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your regional youth housing liaison or email the DFPS housing program.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con el enlace de vivienda para jóvenes de su región o mande un correo al programa de vivienda de DFPS (CPSHousingProgram@dfps.texas.gov).
records.notes: Email CPSHousingProgram@dfps.texas.gov. A step-by-step housing guide is available on the page.

records.name: Medicaid for Transitioning and Former Foster Care Youth
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free health coverage for young adults who were in Texas foster care. It covers doctor visits, prescriptions, hospital care, dental, vision, and rides to appointments.
records.description_es: Seguro médico gratis para jóvenes adultos que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care) en Texas. Cubre visitas al doctor, medicinas, hospital, dentista, lentes y transporte a las citas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Former Foster Care Youth: ages 18-25, in Texas foster care on 18th birthday or older and got Medicaid when aging out; no income limit. Transitioning Foster Care Youth: ages 18-20, in care through 18th birthday, income limits apply, no other insurance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Former Foster Care Youth: de 18 a 25 años, estaba en cuidado de crianza en Texas al cumplir 18 años o después y recibía Medicaid al salir; no hay límite de ingresos. Transitioning Foster Care Youth: de 18 a 20 años, estuvo en cuidado hasta cumplir 18, hay límites de ingresos y no debe tener otro seguro.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com or call 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com o llame al 2-1-1.
records.notes: Transitioning Foster Care Youth income limit about $5,493/month for one person (per HHS page, 2026-09-26). DFPS also references the Former Foster Care in Higher Education (FFCHE) program.

records.name: College Foster Care Liaisons
records.organization: Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (liaisons at each college)
records.description_en: Every Texas public college has at least one foster care liaison who helps students from foster care with enrollment, the tuition waiver, and campus and community resources.
records.description_es: Cada universidad pública de Texas tiene por lo menos una persona de enlace para estudiantes que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care). Esta persona ayuda con la inscripción, la exención de matrícula y los recursos del campus y la comunidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: College students who have experience in foster care.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes universitarios que estuvieron en cuidado de crianza.
records.how_to_apply: Look up your school's liaison in the THECB Foster Care Liaisons list, or ask your college's financial aid or student services office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque a la persona de enlace de su escuela en la lista de Foster Care Liaisons de THECB, o pregunte en la oficina de ayuda financiera o de servicios estudiantiles de su universidad.
records.notes: THECB publishes a Foster Care Liaisons List with names, phone numbers and emails for each college. THECB contact: Director of Student Success (waylon.metoyer@highered.texas.gov).

records.name: HAY Center (Houston Alumni and Youth Center)
records.organization: The HAY Center / Harris County
records.description_en: A one-stop Transition Center for current and former foster youth offering job help, education support, PAL classes, independent living help, and referrals.
records.description_es: Un Centro de Transición donde encuentra todo en un solo lugar para jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care). Ofrece ayuda para encontrar trabajo, apoyo con los estudios, clases PAL, ayuda para vivir por su cuenta y referencias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Current and former foster youth; DFPS Transition Centers also serve homeless and other at-risk youth.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza; los Centros de Transición de DFPS también atienden a jóvenes sin hogar y otros jóvenes en riesgo.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the center during business hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite el centro en horario de oficina.
records.notes: HAY Center website lists 832-927-7000 or 832-927-0016; the DFPS Transition Centers list shows (832) 927-7001. Hours from haycenter.org. Service area assumed Harris County (host county); confirm.

records.name: LifeWorks Youth Resource Center (Transition Center)
records.organization: LifeWorks
records.description_en: LifeWorks helps young people facing homelessness with housing, a drop-in center, counseling, education, and job services. It is also a DFPS Transition Center for foster youth.
records.description_es: LifeWorks ayuda a jóvenes que no tienen hogar con vivienda, un centro de visita sin cita, consejería, estudios y servicios de empleo. También es un Centro de Transición de DFPS para jóvenes en cuidado de crianza (foster care).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Youth and young adults facing homelessness and current/former foster youth. Emergency shelter is for youth 17 and younger; adults 18+ are referred to other shelters.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes y jóvenes adultos sin hogar, y jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza. El refugio de emergencia es para jóvenes de 17 años o menos; a los adultos de 18 o más se les refiere a otros refugios.
records.how_to_apply: Call LifeWorks or visit the center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a LifeWorks o visite el centro.
records.notes: DFPS Transition Center phones: (512) 851-6434 / (800) 414-5457. LifeWorks main line (512) 735-2400, email LWinfo@lifeworksaustin.org. Service area assumed Travis/Central Texas; confirm.

records.eligibility_summary_es: Jóvenes que están o estuvieron en cuidado de crianza (foster care), jóvenes sin hogar y otros jóvenes en riesgo.

records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al centro para que le conecten con ayuda.
records.notes: Toll-free (866) 466-8722. Service area assumed host county; confirm. Confirmed on the official DFPS Transition Centers list (2026-09-26).
